title: Preservation of the circuit invariant under one step
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $G$ be a finite list of Boolean gates, let $g$ be a Boolean gate, and let $s$ be a state. If $s$ satisfies the invariant for $G$, the list obtained by appending $g$ to $G$ is acyclic relative to $n$, and $g$ has distinct arguments with exactly one argument when it is a NOT gate and exactly two arguments when it is an AND or OR gate, then the state produced by applying one construction step to $s$ using $g$ satisfies the invariant for the list obtained by appending $g$ to $G$.
hypotheses_covered: Appending $g$ to $G$ gives a list acyclic relative to $n$
$g$ has one argument if it is a NOT gate and two arguments if it is an AND or OR gate
